headline: Australian Parliament Passes Gas Reservation Scheme to Rein In Energy Costs
summary: Australia's parliament passed a Labor plan to deliberately oversupply the domestic gas market with support from the Coalition in a bid to rein in energy costs.
why: Gas reservation policies alter domestic supply dynamics, affecting energy-intensive industries and utility providers in Australia.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Market intervention aimed at oversupplying domestic gas is designed to lower local energy costs.
